entries.description: Input/output alphabet is the 256 UTF-8 byte values; no tokenizer merges, no vocabulary.
Bounded recurrent working state; dimensions fixed by the architecture spec.

Memory keys are produced by a deterministic seeded random projection: the frozen memory encoder table (uniform in [-1,1), SplitMix64 stream tagged 'core.memory_encoder'), summed over hashed byte trigrams. No corpus statistics.
Learning-rate, bias-rate, epsilon, update-norm bound (delta rule) and rate, decay, trace, gain (Hebbian rule). Chosen on pilot seeds only and frozen before the main online-learning run.
Six teaching/control commands (teach, ask, correct, confirm, forget, repeat), the ' => ' delimiter, and control IDs BOS/EOS/PAD. Full list in model/bootstrap/seed.json.

Symbols, roles, and relation atoms are unit complex phasors computed by the compiled atom-encode circuit from their namespaced name bytes and the seeded table core.reasoner.atom_table (random rows from a SplitMix64 stream); numbers use fractional-power encoding exp(i n theta) with a seeded base theta, from which two tables are initialized: core.reasoner.number_digits (row 10 q + v = number(v 10^q), q < 7) and core.reasoner.number_codebook (row j = number(j - number_range)); encoding and cleanup run in the compiled number-encode and number-decode circuits. Binding is elementwise complex multiplication.

Bounded statement/question grammar: about 45 function words, 8 comparatives (4 dimensions), number words zero-twenty, verb normalizations, and the pronoun 'it'. Content words are open. Operator semantics (class inclusion, transitivity, inheritance, comparison, arithmetic, temporal order, negation, conditionals) are programmed.

W_PROG constants are the deterministic output of the zerolm-wsp circuit compiler run on the typed specifications in model/prog/ (one entry per circuit below); each compiled circuit's SHA-256 is pinned in model/prog/pinned.json. Circuits encode algorithms only: no vocabulary, word list, fact, or corpus statistic.

Circuit memory-read (model/prog/memory-read.json): memory retrieval as a neural ISA program. Constants: a status-column selector and active-status window, attention inverse temperature 32 and minimum read weight 1e-7, read threshold 0.3 and coverage threshold 0.5 (from model/specs/memory.json), a key-word position index, a nearest-code score scale, and a top-2 margin selector.

Circuit memory-encode (model/prog/memory-encode.json): the memory key encoder as a neural ISA program, raw text bytes to pooled key, word rows, and word mask. Constants: ASCII byte-class bounds (digits 48-57, letters 65-90 and 97-122, bytes >= 128 are word bytes), the upper-case offset 32, the '#' pad byte 35, a window gather matrix, a previous-byte selector, a prefix-sum matrix, word ranks, and norm epsilon 0. Hashed rows come from core.memory_encoder. No vocabulary or facts.

Circuit atom-encode (model/prog/atom-encode.json): the vector-symbolic atom encoder as a neural ISA program, the bytes of a namespaced name to a unit complex phasor vector. Constants: three salt bytes (1, 2, 3), a broadcast column of ones, one-hot row selectors, and norm epsilon 0. Hashed rows come from core.reasoner.atom_table (seeded random). No vocabulary or facts.

Circuit number-encode (model/prog/number-encode.json): a decimal numeral (bytes, optional leading minus) to its fractional-power phasor as a neural ISA program. Constants: the ten digit byte codes 48..57, the minus byte 45, a strict lower-triangular place counter, place indices 0..6, one-hot spread and tile selectors, the identity phasor, row pickers, and the conjugation mask. Digit rows come from core.reasoner.number_digits (seeded). Positional decimal notation is the only prior; no vocabulary or facts.

Circuits value-encode, fast-recall, and fast-write (model/prog/value-encode.json, fast-*.json): memory value bytes to rows of core.embed by a byte one-hot (byte indices 0..255); nearest-code cleanup (score 2 x.c - |c|^2, NUL-terminated, top-1 minus top-2 margin); W_FAST pattern separation by core.fast_separator with k-winners-take-all (amplitude 1/sqrt(active)); and the decayed normalized delta rule as two delta_write instructions (decay 0.99, learning rate 1, epsilon 1e-6, from model/specs/memory.json). No vocabulary or facts.

Circuits relation-probe and symbol-cleanup (model/prog/relation-probe.json, symbol-cleanup.json): a role-filler probe (role selection from core.reasoner.roles, binding, bundling, sim >= K - margin over active slots, polarity and role-count filters from metadata column selectors) and nearest-symbol cleanup (cosine against memory.relations.codebook, top-1, and a threshold chosen by a one-hot mode among cleanup_min, symbol_same, pronoun_min from model/specs/reasoning.json). No vocabulary or facts.

Circuits memory-write, memory-forget, memory-compact, and memory-history (model/prog/memory-*.json): every change to the semantic and episodic memory as neural ISA programs: the same-key slot (best active key, score >= same_key_threshold), decode-and-compare of its value, the lowest empty slot, the outcome of teach/correct/confirm, new and updated metadata rows (status codes, unconfirmed/confirmed levels, supersession links), following supersession links for forget, the compaction order (top-k) and link remapping (a permutation matrix), and episodic history by key similarity. Constants: metadata column selectors, status and op codes, slot indices. No vocabulary or facts.

Circuits relation-join, relation-levels, relation-rules, relation-counts, and relation-verdict (model/prog/relation-*.json): the eight operators' decisions as fixed-step recurrences over the C5 graph outputs: negative edges between source and target sets with the shortest proof, level-by-level inheritance with a latched first decision, backward chaining over in-scope rules, counts along 'more' chains by phasor binding and codebook cleanup (one distinct value or a contradiction), and the yes/no/contradiction/unknown combination of findings. Constants: per-operator enable scalars, proof-length scores, readout values -range..range, one-hot verdict selectors. No vocabulary or facts.

Circuit number-decode (model/prog/number-decode.json): cleanup of a noisy number phasor as a neural ISA program: scores against core.reasoner.number_codebook, top-1, and readout of the integer value (constant column -range..range) and the clean codebook row. No vocabulary or facts.

Circuit relation-graph (model/prog/relation-graph.json, roadmap C5): decodes relation slots into a slot x symbol subject-similarity matrix, a one-hot object cleanup matrix (cosine >= 0.3), and polarity masks. Constants: role and metadata-column selectors, 1/d, 1/sqrt(d), 0.5, the cleanup threshold. No vocabulary or facts.

Circuit relation-reach (model/prog/relation-reach.json, roadmap C6): reachability over one relation as a fixed 8-step recurrence with a premise matrix, replacing breadth-first search. Constants: probe threshold 2 - 0.5, symbol cleanup threshold 0.9, an 8-step depth schedule and shift matrix, one enable scalar per inference operator, operator selectors.
